version.data_source_note: Source: official Mega Crit November 2020 STS1 run sample (~123k runs, data/raw/november.json). This snapshot is scoped to that sample only: it is NOT the complete November 2020 dump and is NOT an Oct+Nov combined set. Per-run recording dates were not validated, so scope date_start/date_end are omitted.
version.historical_note: Pre-V2.2-era STS1 statistics recorded on game build 2020-07-30 (the only build kept in this official snapshot; other builds are filtered out and counted in the cohort audit). act_win_delta is a run-level statistical association only and is not causal.

offered_count.description: Card-reward events in floors 1-50 where the card was offered.

picked_run_count.description: Runs with at least one card-reward pick of the card in floors 1-50.

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

picked_run_count.description: Runs with at least one card-reward pick of the card in floors 1-50.

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

Per-run recording dates were not validated, so scope date_start/date_end are omitted.
version.historical_note: Pre-V2.2-era STS1 statistics recorded on game build 2020-07-30 (the only build kept in this official snapshot; other builds are filtered out and counted in the cohort audit). act_win_delta is a run-level statistical association only and is not causal.

offered_count.description: Card-reward events in floors 1-50 where the card was offered.

picked_run_count.description: Runs with at least one card-reward pick of the card in floors 1-50.

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.

picked_run_count.description: Runs with at least one card-reward pick of the card in floors 1-50.

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

picked_run_count.description: Runs with at least one card-reward pick of the card in floors 1-50.

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

picked_run_count.description: Runs with at least one card-reward pick of the card in floors 1-50.

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

repick_rate.description: Pick rate on offers after an earlier reward pick in the same run.
repick_rate.formula: later picks / later offers after first reward pick * 100

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers across all floors 1-50 (global, run-length offers).

act_pick_rate.description: Card-reward picks divided by offers, grouped by act floor range.

first_pick_floor_mean.description: Mean run-level floor of the first card-reward pick.

act_win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card and runs that were offered it but never picked it in the same act; not causal.
act_win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

win_delta.description: Observed run win-rate difference between runs that picked the card anywhere in floors 1-50 and runs offered the card but never picked it in the same run; statistical association only, not causal.
win_delta.formula: picked cohort win rate - comparison cohort win rate

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100

Per-run recording dates were not validated, so scope date_start/date_end are omitted.
version.historical_note: Pre-V2.2-era STS1 statistics recorded on game build 2020-07-30 (the only build kept in this official snapshot; other builds are filtered out and counted in the cohort audit). act_win_delta is a run-level statistical association only and is not causal.

offered_count.description: Card-reward events in floors 1-50 where the card was offered.

picked_run_count.description: Runs with at least one card-reward pick of the card in floors 1-50.

skip_count.description: Offers of the card on reward screens whose recorded choice was SKIP.

final_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of runs with a recorded final deck containing the card.
final_deck_presence_rate.formula: runs containing card / runs with master_deck * 100

final_deck_copy_mean.description: Mean final copies among runs whose final deck contains the card.

final_upgrade_rate.description: Upgraded final copies divided by all final copies of the card.
final_upgrade_rate.formula: upgraded final copies / all final copies * 100

campfire_upgrade_count.description: Recorded SMITH actions for the card on floors above zero.

campfire_upgrade_floor_mean.description: Mean floor of recorded SMITH actions for the card above floor zero.

heart_win_deck_presence_rate.description: Share of heart-win runs (audited The Heart damage encounter at a plausible floor with a native boolean victory) whose recorded final master deck contains the card.
heart_win_deck_presence_rate.formula: heart-win deck runs containing card / heart-win runs with a recorded master deck * 100
